class: A change that adds a new value to a state field the server sends (a new answer state, kind or status) is checked on the server only; every client reader written for the old set of values silently drops or mis-draws the new one, and nothing fails until an end-to-end test of a screen happens to reach that state.
mechanism: Row 21d added outcome state FROM_ENTRIES (status_label = REQ-049 AC-5's message). Three frontend readers knew only COMPUTED / NOT_CONNECTED / REFUSED: StrategyBuilderPage.vue rendered status-label only in not-connected/refused, LiveStrategyCard.vue rendered no label, useStrategyLive.js isOutcome dropped FROM_ENTRIES pushes. The 21d check ran backend tests and one frontend unit file, no e2e and no grep of the readers.

first_seen.where: CI App tests run 40055277230 on build/seq-chunk-2 4a08ce01 (21d merged)
first_seen.evidence: 6 Playwright failures: e2e/strategy-live.spec.ts:64 and :136, e2e/live-strategies.spec.ts:85 on both viewports - 'Expected: "not-connected" Received: "from-entries"' and the not-live REST answer never arriving. Fixed on build/seq-ci-21 6bac88cf (4 single-line mutants killed).

fix: Instance: the three readers handle FROM_ENTRIES (labels shown, never live). Class: a brief that adds a value to a sent state field lists every reader (grep the client for the field and each old value) and gives each one a test for the new value.

detection.note: Guarded for the OutcomeResponse state ONLY (backend/ofo_app/routes/outcome.py): tests/test_answer_state_readers.py parses the Literal with ast and asserts every value is named in useStrategyLive.isOutcome, LiveStrategyCard.vue and StrategyBuilderPage.applyOutcome (REFUSED is its default else branch). Proven: with FROM_ENTRIES removed from the three readers the test fails 3 of 6; on the real tree 6 pass. NOT covered (same Literal shape, readers not swept): outcome.py kind and the NOT_AVAILABLE_YET state model, leg_picker.py state (3 models), tracking.py state and kind, broker_status.py Level and Fix, execution_return.py strategy_state, strategies.py state, chain_push.py and index_push.py state, ready_made.py kind, health.py status; grep of backend/ofo_app for Literal[ on state/status/kind/Level/Fix finds 19 lines, 1 covered; which of the others a frontend reader actually switches on is unmeasured. Blind spots: runtime lookup tables, presence-not-behaviour. Until the others are swept the brief's standing item (d) must still name every reader.
